Name: Boscannabis Kit
Author: victorbosco
Description:
Hey my dudes, it's Bosco here, and this is my first mod ever.

﻿Some info:
﻿ ﻿I based myself on some existing mods to learn, and I also looked into some strains that already exist in places where the holy herb is legalized.
I intend to make updates in the near future, but for now, here's what the mod does and its requirements:


﻿ ﻿Requirements:
﻿ ﻿ ﻿SMAPI - INSTALL THIS BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE!! [Available on Nexus Mods - https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿Json Assets [Available on Nexus Mods - https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿Expanded Preconditions Utility [Available on Nexus Mods - https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6529]
﻿ ﻿ ﻿SpaceCore [Available on Nexus Mods - https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]


﻿ ﻿What the mod does:
﻿ ﻿ ﻿Adds 5 Cannabis strains, as follows:

{[b]Cannabis[/b] - Sold at Pierre's
Status:
"Farming": 1,
"Foraging": 1,
"Mining": 1,
"Fishing": 1,
"Luck": 0,
"MaxStamina": -2,
"MagnetRadius": 0,
"Speed": -1,
"Defense": 0,
"Attack": 0,
"Duration": 240
"Wow, it gives a lot of status." Dude, anyone can work after chilling out.

Status:

This one is the most stolen of all and least consistent with reality, but I don't mind, the mod is mine.


﻿ ﻿What I plan for the future:
﻿ ﻿ ﻿- More strains.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Recipes using the generated flowers.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Improve interaction with some NPCs when given as gifts.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿- Add restrictions to some strains to only grow in a greenhouse.

Questions and suggestions: Find me on Nexus Mods.
